units.source_text: “是吗？”朝仓应了一声，稍稍放慢了脚步。

en.t: Is that so? Asakura replied, and slowed his steps a little.

units.source_text: 过不多久，他很快又把我们两人抛在后头，急匆匆地走在前面了。

en.t: Before long, he soon left the two of us behind again and hurried on ahead.

units.source_text: 我明白了朝仓的用意，但是觉得太没趣了。

en.t: I understood what Asakura intended, but I found it terribly dull.

units.source_text: 到达旅馆安顿下来以前，朝仓和我都恪守信约，对道子什么也没讲。

en.t: Until we reached the inn and settled in, Asakura and I both kept our promise and said nothing at all to Michiko.
